title: Hermes artifact corrupted in the Gradle cache
issue: Android build fails after a corrupted hermes-engine download.
log:
> Task :app:preDebugBuild FAILED

FAILURE: Build failed with an exception.

* What went wrong:

Could not resolve com.facebook.react:hermes-android:0.74.0.
  Could not HEAD https://repo.maven.apache.org/...: checksum failed.
